question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underline segment in the given sentence.**

The affection of her husband __carried her up__ in the midst of all her problems.
solution: The correct answer is "**bore her up**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the **meaning **of the given phrasal verb: • ​**Carried her up**: to sustain someone through a difficult circumstance (कठिन परिस्थिति में किसी को सहारा देकर संभालना।) • Let's look at the meaning of the given **phrasal verbs**. • **tore her up**: to cause someone much g__rief. (किसी को बहुत दुःख पहुँचाना।) • **bore her up**: To help one to endure or persevere through emotional distress. (भावनात्मक संकट के माध्यम से सहने या दृढ़ रहने में मदद करें।) • **stood her up**: to intentionally fails to meet someone when one said they would. (जानबूझकर किसी से मिलने में विफल रहता है जब किसी ने कहा कि वे करेंगे।) • **drove her up**: to make (someone) irritated, angry, or crazy. ((किसी को) चिड़चिड़ा, क्रोधित या पागल बनाना।) • As per the meaning of the given words, "**bore her up**" is the appropriate option to substitute the underline segment in the given sentence __ • ​**Example**: *The presence of her husband at the funeral of her mother **bore her up.**__* ​Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.** **The correct sentence is: **T*he affection of her husband**__ bore__*****__* her up__******__ __**in the midst of all her problems.* 40:Tcae, The correct answer is "**diversity**".
